Undergraduate Students excel in research
Saturday, 16 March 2019
5006 Hits
Two undergraduate students of 2016 Batch brought accolades to the Sports Physiology Laboratory of Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences.
Ms. Snigdha Sharma, (Final MBBS student) presented the ICMR approved STS research work at the MUHS State Level Research Conference for Medical Faculty in Maharashtra Institute of Medical Education & Research (MIMER) held at Pune on 14
th
March 2019 and bagged second prize in the category of presentations of completed funded research projects. Earlier Mr. Sujay Srivastava (Final MBBS Student) also had received second prize in the prestigious International Medical Undergraduate Conference held at Colombo, SriLanka on 7
th
of February 2019. He had presented his ICMR funded STS research in the field of Sports Physiology.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
paragraphs: Two undergraduate students of 2016 Batch brought accolades to the Sports Physiology Laboratory of Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences.

Ms. Snigdha Sharma, (Final MBBS student) presented the ICMR approved STS research work at the MUHS State Level Research Conference for Medical Faculty in Maharashtra Institute of Medical Education & Research (MIMER) held at Pune on 14 th March 2019 and bagged second prize in the category of presentations of completed funded research projects. Earlier Mr. Sujay Srivastava (Final MBBS Student) also had received second prize in the prestigious International Medical Undergraduate Conference held at Colombo, SriLanka on 7 th of February 2019. He had presented his ICMR funded STS research in the field of Sports Physiology.
